fieldValues.title: Measures I1 to I4 as indicator records and per-cycle measurement results
fieldValues.decision_question: How are the programme's measures I1 to I4 recorded and computed?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: (a) argument/indicator records with computed measurement-result records; other forms were considered.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Take (a). I1 to I4 are argument/indicator records (indicator_id, title, measurement_method, baseline_state). I1 is computed by a clerk script that shares canon() with the gate, into an argument/measurement-result record per cycle (result_id, observed_finding, observation_period, evaluator); reports link the results. The baseline is I1 computed retroactively for the pre-walk cycle (about 0%), compared with the next two cycles. I2 to I4 get results when their computations exist.
fieldValues.rationale: Sharing canon() with the gate keeps one reading of what counts as grounded, and results are records, so reports can link them.
